item.title: 0.1.0-beta.3
item.description:
Shan Early Beta

A quiet space for your notes, connected ideas, and AI-assisted thinking.

What you can do with Shan
- Capture thoughts, questions, and links in a native Mac app.
- Connect your ideas with note references, search your notes, and explore them through nested comments.
- Ask an AI agent to explore questions using your notes and, when needed, information from the web.
- Let AI add relevant context and surface connections to earlier notes.
- Keep your notes as Markdown files in your own GitHub repository, with synchronization and version history.

Installation and updates
- Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 26 or later.
- Drag Shan to Applications, then open it.
- This early beta has not been notarized by Apple. If macOS blocks the first launch, open System Settings > Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway.
- Choose Shan > Check for Updates… to install future updates.
